verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Routine rewriting by the triangle inequality. The Lean condition is `20 * K * B ≤ T` with K any bound on |deriv OutgoingSchedule.sigma| (the paper's ‖σ′‖_∞) and B any bound on |logShape η − ℓ_i(η)| = |log f − ℓ_i|; the paper's right-hand side uses 𝓑_0 + ‖log f‖_∞ instead, which bounds that same quantity since ‖log f − ℓ_i‖_∞ ≤ ‖ℓ_i‖_∞ + ‖log f‖_∞ ≤ 𝓑_0 + ‖log f‖_∞ (𝓑_0 is the k = 0 case of (B.32)). So any T_sh meeting (B.33) meets the Lean hypothesis. In the construction the Lean instantiates B = 2·BJ with BJ = max(bound on ℓ_i jets, bound on log f jets) (MatchingDebtBounds.lean:694–697), and 2·max(a,b) ≥ a + b, so its B is itself ≥ 𝓑_0 + ‖log f‖_∞. The factor 20, the direction of the inequality, and the conclusion it buys — the logarithmic slope in [11/20, 13/20] = [.55, .65], the paper's next sentence — agree exactly. Two conventional slacks, both in the safe direction: `sigma_deriv_bounded` yields some bound K on |σ′| rather than the supremum, and `exists_duration` picks T = 1 + 20·K·B rather than the threshold itself.
